_comment:
Allowlist for intentional locale drift, consumed by scripts/check-i18n-keys.mjs.

Schema:
  {
    "missing":       { <locale>: { <namespace>: ["dotted.key", ...] } },
    "extra":         { <locale>: { <namespace>: ["dotted.key", ...] } },
    "sameAsEnglish": { <locale>: { <namespace>: ["dotted.key", ...] } }
  }

- `missing`: keys in en/<ns>.json that are intentionally absent from <locale>/<ns>.json (e.g. brand-only labels that should fall through to English).
- `extra`: keys present in <locale>/<ns>.json that have no English source (e.g. region-specific copy).
- `sameAsEnglish`: leaf string values that are intentionally identical to the English value. Use cases:
    1. Brand & product proper nouns: "QVO", "Quality Voice Operations", "Federated Ingest", "Global Intelligence Network".
    2. Third-party product names: "Salesforce", "HubSpot", "Google Calendar", "Slack", "Zapier".
    3. Single-word borrowings that legitimately stay in English in the target language ("Demo", "Pro", "Workflows", "Dashboard" in German).
    4. Format strings / placeholders / fixture data: "Acme Corp", "Jane Smith", "n={{n}}", "© {{year}} Quality Voice Operations".
    5. API event names and identifiers: "call.started", "webhook".
  Anything not listed here whose non-English value matches the English value byte-for-byte is treated as drift ("translator forgot to translate this") and fails CI.

Seed note: the bulk of the entries below are the current state of `client-app/src/locales/{de,es,fr,pt-BR}/{tenant,admin}.json`, which were bootstrapped with English copy and never received a full translation pass. They are listed here so the check runs green today; as proper translations land, the corresponding entries should be removed from this allowlist (the check will then enforce that they stay translated).
